description: This is a Python source file for a Streamlit-based chatbot application that integrates with language models (OpenAI and Gemini), SQL database, and external APIs to generate SQL queries and answers based on user input. It includes functions for prompt generation, model interaction, data retrieval, and cost calculation.

methods.name: generate_prompt
methods.description: Generates a prompt string combining user question and additional context for model input.

methods.name: openai_model
methods.description: Sends a message to OpenAI chat completion API and returns the response.

methods.name: get_query
methods.description: Extracts SQL query enclosed within ```sql ... ``` from model output.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Executes a SQL query against the database and returns fetched rows.

methods.name: generate_final_prompt
methods.description: Creates a comprehensive prompt for answer generation based on question, SQL, data, and table info.

methods.name: get_text_content
methods.description: Extracts text content from Gemini model response parts.

methods.name: cost_counter
methods.description: Calculates total token-based cost for query and answer outputs.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main Streamlit app function managing user interaction, model calls, data retrieval, and display.
